<description>
Previously, `interface_bitcoin_cli.py` required the `-rpcwaittimeout=5` path to wait at least 5 wall-clock seconds before failing to connect. Under Docker CI load the process can return a few tens of milliseconds early (~40ms observed), so the floor assert flakes.

Fix by allowing 0.1s scheduling slack on that wait floor and reduce `-rpcwaittimeout` to `1`.
</description>

<commits>
7445428eb8 test: allow slack on rpcwaittimeout wait floor
</commits>

<files>
test/functional/interface_bitcoin_cli.py  +3/-2

(test/bench/ci lines: 5)
</files>

<patch>
diff --git a/test/functional/interface_bitcoin_cli.py b/test/functional/interface_bitcoin_cli.py
index e631191516..851bd7ae9e 100755
--- a/test/functional/interface_bitcoin_cli.py
+++ b/test/functional/interface_bitcoin_cli.py
@@ -477,8 +477,9 @@ class TestBitcoinCli(BitcoinTestFramework):
         self.log.info("Test -rpcwait option waits at most -rpcwaittimeout seconds for startup")
         self.stop_node(0)  # stop the node so we time out
         start_time = time.time()
-        assert_raises_process_error(1, "Could not connect to the server", self.nodes[0].cli('-rpcwait', '-rpcwaittimeout=5').echo)
-        assert_greater_than_or_equal(time.time(), start_time + 5)
+        assert_raises_process_error(1, "Could not connect to the server", self.nodes[0].cli('-rpcwait', '-rpcwaittimeout=1').echo)
+        # Allow small scheduling slack. rpcwaittimeout is best effort wall clock.
+        assert_greater_than_or_equal(time.time() + 0.1, start_time + 1)
 
         self.log.info("Test that only one of -addrinfo, -generate, -getinfo, -netinfo may be specified at a time")
         assert_raises_process_error(1, "Only one of -getinfo, -netinfo may be specified", self.nodes[0].cli('-getinfo', '-netinfo').send_cli)

</patch>
